owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: Project slippage and failure to meet objectives of projects.

owl:NamedIndividual.terms:creator: Rob
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: Operational risks relate to the day-to-day delivery of activities, operational business plans and objectives. Operational risks typically have a short-term focus. Whilst they may impact a number of areas of the service, this does not necessarily make them a strategic risk. Operational risks may have the ability to impact strategic and other operational risks.
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Operational Risk
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: Operational risks relate to the day-to-day delivery of activities, operational business plans and objectives. Operational risks typically have a short-term focus. Whilst they may impact a number of areas of the service, this does not necessarily make them a strategic risk. Operational risks may have the ability to impact strategic and other operational risks.

owl:NamedIndividual.terms:creator: Rob
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: Project risks relate to the achievement and delivery of the project objectives and outcomes. The majority of project risks are short term in nature and exist for the term of the project, whilst some will be on-going and re-classified at the end of the project. Projects can be defined as temporary, with the aim of delivering outcomes within a specified timeframe.
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Project Risk
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: Project risks relate to the achievement and delivery of the project objectives and outcomes. Projects can be defined as temporary, with the aim of delivering outcomes within a specified timeframe.

owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Residual Risk Rating
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: The remaining level of risk after all treatment plans have been implemented.

owl:NamedIndividual.terms:creator: Rob
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: Using information from incident management to inform a proactive approach to managing risk. Data relating to incidents which occur is a critical source of information about risk. Incident data can be used both to identify risk and also to monitor the effectiveness of actions taken to prevent its recurrence.
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Respond
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: Using information from incident management to inform a proactive approach to managing risk. Data relating to incidents which occur is a critical source of information about risk. Incident data can be used both to identify risk and also to monitor the effectiveness of actions taken to prevent its recurrence.

owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: Informed decision to take a particular risk.
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Risk Acceptance
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: Informed decision to take a particular risk.

owl:NamedIndividual.terms:creator: Rob
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: Amount and type of risk that an organisation is willing to pursue or retain.

owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: Amount and type of risk that an organisation is willing to pursue or retain.

owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Risk Assessment
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: Overall process of risk identification, risk analysis and risk evaluation.

owl:NamedIndividual.terms:creator: Rob
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: Informed decision not to be involved in, or to withdraw from, an activity in order not to be exposed to a particular risk. Risk avoidance may increase the significance of other risks or may lead to the loss of opportunities for gain.
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Risk Avoidance
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: Informed decision not to be involved in, or to withdraw from, an activity in order not to be exposed to a particular risk. Risk avoidance may increase the significance of other risks or may lead to the loss of opportunities for gain.

owl:NamedIndividual.terms:creator: Rob
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: The categories used by the organisation to group similar opportunities or risks for the purposes of reporting and assigning responsibility.
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Risk Categories
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: The categories used by the organisation to group similar opportunities or risks for the purposes of reporting and assigning responsibility.

owl:NamedIndividual.terms:creator: Rob
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: Terms of reference against which the significance of a risk is evaluated.
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Risk Criteria
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: Terms of reference against which the significance of a risk is evaluated.

owl:NamedIndividual.terms:creator: Rob
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: In instances where a risk was notified to and accepted onto the register of a more Senior Manager for oversight it may be that following the implementation of actions the rating of the risk may have reduced to an acceptable or tolerable level or where remaining actions lie within the control of the Manager at the level below. In such circumstances a decision may be taken to ‘close’ the risk on the register and to de-escalate it onto the register of the Manager on the level below. Such risks when added to the register below are given a risk status of ‘open’ on that register and are reviewed at the next Management Team meeting of that Manager.
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Risk De-Escalation
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: In instances where a risk was notified to and accepted onto the register of a more Senior Manager for oversight it may be that following the implementation of actions the rating of the risk may have reduced to an acceptable or tolerable level or where remaining actions lie within the control of the Manager at the level below. In such circumstances a decision may be taken to ‘close’ the risk on the register and to de-escalate it onto the register of the Manager on the level below. Such risks when added to the register below are given a risk status of ‘open’ on that register and are reviewed at the next Management Team meeting of that Manager.

owl:NamedIndividual.terms:creator: Rob
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: Process of comparing the results of risk analysis with risk criteria to determine whether the risk and/or its magnitude is acceptable or tolerable.
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Risk Evaluation
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: Process of comparing the results of risk analysis with risk criteria to determine whether the risk and/or its magnitude is acceptable or tolerable.

owl:NamedIndividual.terms:creator: Rob
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: A systematic process applied to the organisation’s objectives and activities to identify possible risk sources and causes and potential consequences or impacts should a risk occur.
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Risk Identification
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: A systematic process applied to the organisation’s objectives and activities to identify possible risk sources and causes and potential consequences or impacts should a risk occur.

owl:NamedIndividual.terms:creator: Rob
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: A risk profile is a written description of a set of risks. A risk profile can include the risks that the entire organisation must manage or only those that a particular function or part of the organisation must address. (In the HSE, a services risk profile is set out in their risk register).
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Risk Profile
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: A risk profile is a written description of a set of risks. A risk profile can include the risks that the entire organisation must manage or only those that a particular function or part of the organisation must address. owl:NamedIndividual.terms:creator: Rob
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: With the completion of some or all of the actions the level of risk (the rating) may be reassessed in order to consider whether its likelihood or impact score has reduced.
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:label: Risk Re-Rating
owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:definition: With the completion of some or all of the actions the level of risk (the rating) may be reassessed in order to consider whether its likelihood or impact score has reduced.

owl:NamedIndividual.terms:creator: Rob
owl:NamedIndividual.rdfs:comment: A risk register is a database of assessed risks that face any organisation at any one time. Always changing to reflect the dynamic nature of risks and the organisation’s management of them, its purpose is to help managers prioritise available resources to minimise risk and target improvements to best effect.

owl:NamedIndividual.skos1:prefLabel: Risks Notified From Another Organisation Level

Strategic risks relate to the highest level of objective for the HSE, which typically have a long-term focus and are linked to the HSE’s Strategic Plan.
